_about: Project Immortal audio requests. Read by immortal/tools/elevenlabs-assets.cjs on GitHub Actions (workflow immortal-audio.yml). Every finished file is kept by its id; changing an entry's text/prompt regenerates only that entry. Voice ids are not secrets.

aren.name: Aren (Project Immortal)
aren.description: A 14-year-old boy, voice not yet broken, soft and slightly husky from exhaustion. Thin, breathy and fragile, as if he has been running all night. Natural and unpolished, quiet, close to the microphone. No accent drama, not a cartoon voice.
aren.preview_text: Father? It's me. I ran all night. I kept falling, and every time I fell I thought I wouldn't get up again. But I did. I don't know how. I don't know what happened to me. Please, just look at me. It's me.

father.name: Father (Project Immortal)
father.description: A rugged 40-year-old man, low and rough voice worn by cold air and smoke, speaking quietly with restraint. Warm underneath, but now trembling and afraid. Natural, intimate, unpolished, no announcer tone.
father.preview_text: I watched them take you. I stood there and I let them walk you up to the stones, and I did nothing. I told your sister you were gone. So tell me. How are you standing here? How are you alive?

lines.tagged: [quiet, trembling] I watched them take you.
[barely a whisper, afraid] How are you alive?
[confused, small, close to tears] I don't know.
